facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.

Grimny's ghost says Bral, who lost the party the map in a gambling bet, probably hid the treasure in the Dragon's Lair, a very small one-room cave marked on the map that the dwarves once scouted and found empty.
Dr. Uriah's Read Languages spell reveals the writing under one treasure-map location per day.
What is the one remaining unidentified location marked on the treasure map? Sir Phidipaldi guesses it is King Hogboon's, whose goblin castle lies in a ruined temple near an unmarked area of the map.

The dragon is believed to occupy the Dragon's Lair, where the treasure is probably hidden, which blocks recovering it; Dunk speculates there is no dragon, only Bral pretending there is one to keep people away.
